headline: Gerdes Downgrades Range Resources Rating to Neutral on Valuation
summary: Brokerage firm Gerdes cut its rating on natural gas producer Range Resources to neutral, citing limited valuation upside.
why: Range Resources is an independent US natural gas exploration and production company operating extensively in the Appalachian Basin.

impacts.name: Range Resources
impacts.why: Brokerage downgrades on valuation grounds prompt institutional investors to rebalance allocations away from the equity.

why_moved: A rating downgrade directly impacts market sentiment and leads short-term traders to adjust positions downward.
